verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI documents scriptable, non-interactive automation with structured JSON output and multi-directory context (gh-6, gh-16, gh-17/18) plus large-codebase querying and operational task automation (gh-1, gh-4), which together enable bulk/batch-style operations across many files or items. However, there is no explicit documented feature (e.g., a batch-processing command or looped multi-item workflow example) demonstrating bulk operations at scale, and community reports note navigation/tool-calling weaknesses on large codebases (gemini-cli-comm-12, gemini-cli-comm-13). Missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch operation examples or docs, and independent confirmation of reliable performance across many items at once.
